mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO billing_account (namespace, plan_code, status) VALUES (#{namespace}, #{planCode}, 'active')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM billing_account WHERE namespace = #{namespace} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM billing_account WHERE _id = #{accountId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM billing_plan WHERE plan_code = #{planCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO billing_period (account_id, period_start, period_end, quota_bytes, billed_bytes) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{quotaBytes}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT u._id, u.account_id, u.tunnel_id, u.window_start, u.usage_bytes, u.billed_bytes FROM tunnel_usage_window u INNER JOIN cluster c ON c.cluster_id = u.cluster_id WHERE c.region = #{region} AND u.usage_bytes > u.billed_bytes ORDER BY u.window_start ASC, u._id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_usage_10m (account_id, tunnel_id, window_start, usage_bytes) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{tunnelId}, #{windowStart}, #{usageBytes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE usage_bytes = usage_bytes + VALUES(usage_bytes)
